Name: TID_MISSION_1_0_OBJECTIVE
Text: Okay, look here on page 72: \qlow-pressure maintenance flow\q. We should be able to reroute a trickle of water back to the Oasis. Just access the flow control system - I'm guessing that's an AI terminal somewhere in the Plant's offices.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_1_OBJECTIVE
Text: We keep getting good tips from two hobos living in the area. Labycore tends to leave them alone, and sometimes they overhear useful stuff.\n\nThey usually hang out in the sewer system - where the mutants now lurk. Can you make sure they're ok?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_1_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Pink elephants? I'm starting to believe Jonas after what we've seen in the last few days.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_1_TALK_TASK_0
Text: I'm seeing pink elephants, not much else. Hey, can you buy me a drink my friend?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_1_TALK_TASK_1
Text: Jonas is talking out of his ass. They're red elephants, not pink. And mutants, not elephants.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_10_OBJECTIVE
Text: You seen the Raiders? A gang of bloodthristy gringos with face paint and stupid haircuts. There's a bunch of them right there. Why don't you get acquainted?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_10_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Nice moves ese! The Raiders are pushing into our territory. Maybe you can help us shove them back?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_11_OBJECTIVE
Text: Talk to Luscious Valkyrie when you are ready to defend the basketball court

Name: TID_MISSION_1_11_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Not bad, stranger! Not only did we earn ourselves a bit of rest, but also thinned their numbers quite nicely. It'll take a while before their medics patch that many bullet holes.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_12
Text: A Soft Heart is an Easy Target

Name: TID_MISSION_1_12_OBJECTIVE
Text: Find the Valkyrie in Freedom Park and escort her to safety.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_12_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I didn't know that Hooligans in Old Town are looking for something. Usually they just drink and pass out, and look for people to mug. What on earth are they up to?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_13_OBJECTIVE
Text: Interrogate the Hooligan leader Scooter on Freedom Island.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_13_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Eastern Queens want an abandoned location for a base... Hm. They're probably planning on expanding their business, which means more girl slaves for their joy division. I bet Freedom Island isn't the only place where they've been planning to expand. Let's keep our eyes and ears open, right?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_14_OBJECTIVE
Text: Search for the 13 Diablos Member in New Venice Hotel.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_14_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I'm so relieved to hear that my buddy's all right. I'd better buy him a round or five tonight to compensate for this.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_14_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Ow, holy cow my head hurts... Maybe this wasn't such a bright idea after all...

Name: TID_MISSION_1_15_OBJECTIVE
Text: Deliver Fall's message to Voodoo Mambo in New Venice Square.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_15_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks for talking to the mambo in my stead. Those Sewer Voodoos give me the heebiejeebies with their mumbojumbo.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_15_TALK_TASK_0
Text:
We do as ya ask, mon, but know this! We knows what ya want, mon. Yah, brah - the loa hear ya, see ya... Taste ya.
We have a destiny together, brah. A destiny of blood and fire. We fight side by side to slay da shadows, mon.
But da time isn't yet, mon.
Now, go.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_16_OBJECTIVE
Text: We're going to raid that warehouse. Anything so well guarded has to contain something important. Clear out the outside guards first.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_16_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Those mercs sure got served! All right, let's have a look at the situation.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_17_OBJECTIVE
Text: The crazy Mutant outcasts are lurking in the sewage system. We keep hearing noises from that garage over there. Whatever those red devils are up to, it's bound to be no good. Find out what they're planning and if possible, stop them.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_17_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: A bomb? The muties are much more dangerous than I thought. Thanks for saving our skins!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_18_OBJECTIVE
Text: I still can't believe you're willing to risk your butt for those monsters. Go check out that lab if you must, but make sure you bring in enough firepower. Who knows what's lurking down there!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_18_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That's some gruesome stuff you're telling me. Were they really experimenting on Dawnbreak citizens?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_19_OBJECTIVE
Text: Now that you mention it, a company called GenTec used to run a facility in Mill Park. There was an accident, and now the buildings are abandoned, as far as I know.\n\nIf you want to go check it out, you should probably cut power to the lab's security systems first.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_19_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Listen. GenTec was experimenting with, you guessed it, gene technology. Their facility was abandoned after some freak accident that killed a dozen of their workers and horribly disfigured many others. The way's clear, but are you really ready to do this?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_2_OBJECTIVE
Text: These Hired Guns' security contractin' days are over. Shoot them all - I couldn't finish them off because my gun jammed.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_20_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Duke: My brother Dean is a crazy bastard. He says he doesn't fight for the Resistance, but he keeps getting into trouble with the Man all the time. This time I'm afraid he's gone too far. Bring back what's left of him, ok?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_20_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Look, I was making noise on purpose to bring those chicken shits out of their hidey-holes. It worked, didn't it?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_20_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Hah! So little Duke's worried about me? He's always been a pussy. Are you a pussy? We're about to find out.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_21_OBJECTIVE
Text: You can bet your ass the Labbies will come looking for these assclowns. So much the better. Get out there and say hi for me! If you do well, my buddy Scarface will have something for you.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_21_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Their screaming reminded me of my first wife. Good times, good times.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_22_OBJECTIVE
Text: I heard Duke's planning to bring in supplies by chopper. Doesn't he know that Labycore has airborne combat drones patrolling the area? See for yourself, there's a drone control room right next door!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_22_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: What did you do? The drones dropped right out of the sky. One almost landed on me.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_23_OBJECTIVE
Text: Find the Club Flesh Hedonist in the Abyssos Field Office and show him what pain is.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_23_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good going there! Let's hope he was the right guy.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_24_OBJECTIVE
Text: Ok, step two. Enter the warehouse and have a look around. I'm sure there will be some security inside as well, so deal with them as you please.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_24_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Just data? No guns or money? Ok then, I'd better have a look at these plans.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_25_OBJECTIVE
Text: Kill the Engineer near the huge drill at the Processing Plant.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_25_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: It was about time the drill stopped.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_26_OBJECTIVE
Text: Collect a Drill Parts from Processing Plant yard.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_26_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You got all of them? Great.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_27_OBJECTIVE
Text: One more thing - get the blueprints from the warehouse.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_27_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great job, now we have everything we need.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_28_OBJECTIVE
Text: Steal two canisters of gasoline from the warehouse.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_29_OBJECTIVE
Text: Ruin the W.U.Z.Z. stacks in southern Malloy Waterfront, and get rid of the Mad Dogs present.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_29_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good. Good. That ruined batch of W.U.Z.Z. will wreck a whole lot of W.U.Z.Z. when they start refining the stuff.\nThis here, what we just did? Just tip of the ice berg. We'll keep busting their heads until candy comes out.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_3_OBJECTIVE
Text: Now that we have water, thanks to you, more and more refugees are coming in from the desert. I have to concentrate on running the Health Station. Davey, my lieutenant, will brief you on our other plans.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_3_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: It's time to open the floodgates.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_30_OBJECTIVE
Text: Open the safe in Office 02 in Malloy Waterfront

Name: TID_MISSION_1_30_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Nice job, friend! Now we know when the next smuggling shipment is coming.\nHmm... It's apparently new movies from the mainland. Excellent! Those will definitely help keep morale up in these trying times.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_31_OBJECTIVE
Text: You'll have to go to Labycore's ad agency to find out if this weapon coupon business is for real. Dreamlab, that's what they call it. You'll find it right over there.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_31_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Sample coupons printed and ready for transport\n\n> Full Bang-O-Mat money transfer compliance certified

Name: TID_MISSION_1_31_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Augh... *koff* *koff* Is that... Is that blood I'm coughing up? Effin' Dogs...\nThey got this big W.U.Z.Z. shipment going, and they got all angry when I didn't clear their papers. Sure taught me a lesson to stand up to bullies, eh?\n*koff*

Name: TID_MISSION_1_32_OBJECTIVE
Text: Destroy the Mad Dog smugglers' motorboat in Malloy Waterfront.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_32_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Whoa! I had no idea the boat would burn that brightly! The upholstery in the boat must've been highly flammable. Those fake furs are dangerous, as we can see!\nGood work my friend!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_33_FINISHED_SOCIAL_NETWORK_POST
Text: Mister Ironbar was vicious and mean, psychotic and sadistic, but still he was no match for yours truly.\nYeah, that's right. I capped his ass.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_33_OBJECTIVE
Text: Some of the Raiders, led by a fellow calling himself Blackbeard, have found a speedboat and turned to piracy. They're not really sailors any more than they are original with their names, but we can't allow our supply deliveries to be disturbed. Keel-haul Tollmanbeard!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_33_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Shiver me timbers! You done me proud, laddie! All right, I'll stop now. Good job taking out Blackbeard and his pirates.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_34_OBJECTIVE
Text: The mutant threat here is growing. I don't know how, but they seem to be more organized now. Who's giving them weapons, ammo and gas for those nightmarish chainsaws?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_34_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: We need to figure out how those mutants keep getting into sewers right beneath us. I have a feeling Labycore's behind all this.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_35_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Authentication key required for flow control changes

Name: TID_MISSION_1_36_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Pump(s) 0003, 0074, 0092: maximum maintenance flow [ 10 % ] of water redirected to Zone 8

Name: TID_MISSION_1_36_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: My friend, you saved the Health Station in the nick of time. Our water reserves were almost spent. Now we have a small but steady supply of water, and I doubt the mercs suspect anything.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_37_OBJECTIVE
Text: Private security contractors are one thing. Sadistic gunslingers who shoot on sight and deny us water is another thing entirely. Do a kind act and kill any Hired Guns you find.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_37_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You've made Paradise Island a better place. It's still closer to purgatory than paradise, but we're getting there.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_38_OBJECTIVE
Text: Our number one goal is to secure a reliable water supply. The Water Purification Plant that's to the North of here would be ideal, but first we have to figure out how to control it. One of my homies has found an operating manual. Go check it out for me!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_38_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Yeah, you got it. The manual is on that dead merc.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_39
Text: The Way of the Exploding Pig

Name: TID_MISSION_1_4
Text: Duke of All Kinds of Hazards

Name: TID_MISSION_1_4_OBJECTIVE
Text: Thanks for your help on Paradise Island. If you're looking for more action, you might want to check out Steel Island next. Duke is the man to meet. He won't hesitate to send you in harm's way!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_4_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I've been expecting you! We could really use a hero around here. That's right, hero of Paradise Island! The Diablos speak very highly of you.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_40_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Davey: Listen up! The Hired Guns are making a counter-attack on the reservoir. I repeat, you're under attack! Get out there and hold your positions!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_41_OBJECTIVE
Text: Somehow the Mad Dogs have got their hands on a Labycore autonomous tank. It's an old model but plenty dangerous, and we can't afford to wait and let it come to us. Get a team together and attack the compound where they're outfitting the tank.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_41_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That was a close call. How the hell did these yoyos get Labycore war gear? We need to figure out their source and put a stop to this nonsense.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_42_OBJECTIVE
Text: Kill Pimp Mother in Casino Royale!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_42_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That Madame's pimpin' days are over. Great job!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_43_OBJECTIVE
Text: One of my crew has infiltrated a Labycore subcontractor. Larry's been real quiet for a while now. Find out what's going on.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_43_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Ok that's it, my cover's blown for sure.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_44_OBJECTIVE
Text: The Raiders are big on combat sports. They just crowned a new champion after a huge gladiator show last weekend. You know what they say - to be the champ you gotta beat the champ!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_44_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Well done, you did good - even if the Champ was still exhausted from his tournament fights. The same goes for all of the Raiders, let's hope they keep fighting each other and leave us alone.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_45_OBJECTIVE
Text: We need power to survive out here. There's a solar farm out on the Plantation, see if you can't start it up!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_46_OBJECTIVE
Text: Trying to get the power online? Not going to happen without the admin key cards. The Raiders took them when they looted this place.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_46_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: The admin cards! How did you find them? Never mind, let's just get the system booted up.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_47_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Duke: Look, we have a chopper ready to go with guns and supplies. Take over the helipad so we can bring the bird in. Security should be minimal, a few troopers and something called ED-187, whatever that is.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_47_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Say what? The innocent sounding acronym turned out to be a super killer mech?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_48_OBJECTIVE
Text: Destroy the two bulldozers in Ratched Lane.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_48_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Excellent. With the bulldozers destroyed, the construction process is halted. We can get more men in place - soon we can prepare for the final assault.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_49_OBJECTIVE
Text: Eliminate Hired Guns in Ratched Lane.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_49_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good job! I'm sure that the Hired Guns insurance policy covers loss of limbs, blood, sight and life. Even if it doesn't, I don't really care. They know what they sign up for.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_5_OBJECTIVE
Text: One of the junkies living in the sewer system here told me about Mad Mutants trying to hatch giant ant eggs down there. I'm not sure if he's just hallucinating, but we'd better check it out.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_5_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Look at these. Wow, he wasn't hallucinating at all. What the heck are we going to do with these eggs?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_50_OBJECTIVE
Text: Want to make history? You're just in time. Our attack on the power plant is about to begin. I want you to join the fray, take out the Spiderbot and salvage its AI for access codes.\n\nOur guys a rearing to go. Are you ready?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_50_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good job opening that gate, friend.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_51_OBJECTIVE
Text: Eliminate Hired Guns presence in Bromden Park.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_51_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Man, you are one powerhouse of a fighter. Tremendous work!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_52_OBJECTIVE
Text: Locate two weapon crates in Bromden Park.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_52_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Excellent! Two full crates of automatic weapons will sure go a long way here. I doubt that the mercenaries will just give up, but at least we now have more means of persuasion than just kind words.\nGood work.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_53_OBJECTIVE
Text: Mutants have run over Mill Park! One of them caught my eye though. It seems to be hiding from the other muties and lurking around the old test facilities. Wanna go check it out?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_53_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That's interesting. So you're telling me there are good mutants and bad mutants? What's up with that?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_54_OBJECTIVE
Text: Clear out the Hooligans from the other side of the road.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_54_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That should give us some pore space to work.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_55_OBJECTIVE
Text: Take out the Labycore Van In the Parkinglot of the Asylum

Name: TID_MISSION_1_56_OBJECTIVE
Text: Steal two generators from the Asylym yard for Simon Hibbert

Name: TID_MISSION_1_56_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good Job My friend. I think our job here is done for the moment. I bet we shall see each other soon enough.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_58_OBJECTIVE
Text: Escort Reggie Westwood to the gates leading to Bromden Park.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_58_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Nice work partner! I opened the gate for you.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_58_TASK_0
Text: Escort Reggie to the gates leading to Bromden Park

Name: TID_MISSION_1_59_OBJECTIVE
Text: Eliminate Labycore Personnel in McMurphy Asylum

Name: TID_MISSION_1_59_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Nice collection of dog tags you got there my friend.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_6_OBJECTIVE
Text: It's a big payday for the Guns. Labycore has been covertly funding their violent rampage for months now, and they're negotiating a new contract. Time to shut down the talks.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_6_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Dillinger: Those mercenaries won't lift a finger without a monetary compensation. You've just bought us some much needed breathing space.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_60_OBJECTIVE
Text: Kill Hired Guns from the other side of the street in McMurphy Asylum

Name: TID_MISSION_1_60_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Nice one! Now we can work out the labyknot in pease.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_61_OBJECTIVE
Text: Clear out Labycore personnel in the Asylum Yard and destroy their truck.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_61_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Nice Job friend! Next we will try something strange..

Name: TID_MISSION_1_62_OBJECTIVE
Text: Go with Reggie To Meet Up With Trooper Sid

Name: TID_MISSION_1_62_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Greetings. I'm Sid. The supply manager for the labycore. I signed up for this job in good intensions, but as you can see from the condition of dawnbrake things didn't go as planned.. I'll help you bring the Labycore as well as Sid Lovens Down!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_63_OBJECTIVE
Text: Clear the 1st Asylum Floor from hostiles.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_63_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Oh you found the blueprints! Nice one!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_64_OBJECTIVE
Text: Fetch the devise parts from Labycore Helipad. In McMurphy Asylum

Name: TID_MISSION_1_64_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Nice I'll throw these over the fence so they will be with the fishes.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_65_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: A note.. No. A List! This Is a List!! Let's see..\n\nOwmagawd!! These are bodyparts and the lists says they are kept in the asylums cellar. Go see what the hell is going on in there.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_66_OBJECTIVE
Text: Go download the research data for trooper sid from the asylum cellar

Name: TID_MISSION_1_66_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: This is big.. This is really big!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_67_OBJECTIVE
Text: Go Give Reggie Westwood Asylums Data

Name: TID_MISSION_1_67_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Whoah. We are up for a massive adveture if we are going to get this plot solved!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_68_OBJECTIVE
Text: McMurphy Asylum isn't a real mental institution. Maybe they used to have actual patients, but the only occupants right now are people that Labycore considers dissidents. Our guy inside will give you the details.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_68_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Right here, mate. I can tell you're no Labster.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_69_OBJECTIVE
Text: A bunch of our guys infiltrated the asylum, but Mac the Janitor is the only one we've seen since. We don't dare make contact from here, so we're counting on the next brave volunteer to go in and talk to him. I guess you're the lucky one.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_69_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Finally someone showed up! I'm sick and tired of janitoring. Listen, I found out something you won't believe.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_7_OBJECTIVE
Text: We need to disrupt the mercs' communications so they can't call in reinforcements.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_7_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good job. It's time to move on the main objective.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_70_OBJECTIVE
Text: I overheard two orderlies talking about a \qpatient\q called Jimbo, inmate number 6733. Could that be Jimbo B, legendary commander of the resistance? If only I could hack the security system and check his ID...

Name: TID_MISSION_1_71_OBJECTIVE
Text:
> ID #6733 /// Checking Immigration Data of inmate #6733

*** DATA CLASSIFIED ***

> Force unlock #6733 /// Security locks released

Name: TID_MISSION_1_71_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Who are you? Is this another one of Labycore's subversions? Leave me be!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_72_OBJECTIVE
Text: All right, I shall play along. The evil mind behind McMurphy Asylum is Dr. Seiter, a vicious sadist who calls himself a scientist. If you are truly fighting for the Resistance, it is your duty to put an end to that madman.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_72_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Are you kidding me? You rescued the legendary Jimbo B and killed the asylum superintendent? You're a human wrecking machine, dude.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_73_OBJECTIVE
Text: McMurphy Asylum is the local loonie bin, but people who go in there never seem to come back out. Recently some undercover resistance fighters got themselves interned. Talk to Reggie, he should know more.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_73_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Shh. They havent seen us yet..

Name: TID_MISSION_1_74_OBJECTIVE
Text: Water is more precious than gold, but we had to leave some water behind when evacuating the Resort. I doubt the Raiders are smart enough to open the electronic locks.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_74_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: ( Spits ) The Hired Guns got there first and took our last drops of water.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_75_OBJECTIVE
Text: The Raiders drive around in their trucks, yelling and whooping day and night. It's driving me crazy! Get rid of their wheels and we'll be safer from attacks too.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_76_OBJECTIVE
Text: The bastard Raiders knocked out our supply truck. Help Jorge the driver gather up and defend the cargo!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_76_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks <PLAYER_NAME>. You've helped us out big time.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_76_TALK_TASK_1
Text: The Raiders are back for more!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_77_OBJECTIVE
Text: I'm cooking my husband's favorite food: Giant Ant Eggs with Cactus Sauce. But, oh my! We've run out of Ant Eggs. Could you be a dear and find some for us? Thank you SO much!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_77_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Omnomnom. Thank you darling. And you, stranger, you have my undying gratitude.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_78_OBJECTIVE
Text: How can I have any pudding if I don't eat my meat? I love Ant meat more than anything else in the whole wide world - except of course my wonderful wife, she's the best. Savory Ant heads come close second though. Would you please bring me some?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_79_OBJECTIVE
Text: Investigate the abandoned Power Station and its underground caverns for us. We're thinking of making a move to drive the Eastern Queens out of the district, and the caverns lead right there.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_79_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Mutants!? Giant Ants!? Ok.. I think we will let Eastern Queens hold on to that part of their turf, thanks so much.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_8_OBJECTIVE
Text: Let's thin out the Hired Guns patrols. That should allow us to make a move on the water reservoirs.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_53_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Little human! The New Breed sent me here to find out about our past and the Transformation, but I'm too scared to go to the creepy lab next door.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_80_OBJECTIVE
Text: We're ready to attack the Labycore R&D facility as soon as you disable the emergency generator. You are going in undercover - take this ID tag, head into the basement and kill the custodian. Then go meet up with Wolfe in the lobby.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_80_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Vell done! With ze emergency generator offline, it vas easy to take zis place over. Now all ve need to do is raid ze other floors.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_81_OBJECTIVE
Text: Dr. Bauhoff, ze chief of Labycore's latest robotics projects, is a firm believer in transhumanism. Head into ze Robotics Bay and show him his bionics are no match for ze human spirit!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_81_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: With ze good doctor dead, my boys will go in and corrupt all his research data. Zat should prove to be a major blow to Labycore. Ha!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_82_OBJECTIVE
Text: Doctor Catherine, ze head of Labycore's new weapons projects, used to be a homeopath. Now if you ask me she is more like a psychopath. Hah! Go show her she should've stuck to ear candles and sugar pills.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_82_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good job! Vith ze weapons research labs cleared, my men can loot a some equipment for zemselves. Zis should help in ze coming battle.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_83_OBJECTIVE
Text: It's time ve strike at ze heart of zis facility! Take ze elevator to ze top floor and kill ze Labycore VIPs holled up in zere. My men vill provide fire support and make sure zey can't escape via helicopter. Now go! Zis entire plan hinges on you!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_83_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Looks like our air support got there right on time. Wolfe is still inside clearing out any remaining Labycore personnel, but your job here is done. This is a great day for the Resistance! Hurrah!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_84_OBJECTIVE
Text: Labycore gives their VIPs a few extra \qbonuses\q at the Queen of Diamond's club.\n\nThe VIPs will never be this vulnerable, this is a perfect chance to kill them.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_84_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That's how we treat Labycore VIPs! Yeah!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_85_OBJECTIVE
Text: Queen of Diamonds club caters for every sin, so their fighting arena gathers all the biggest stars. This is a perfect opportunity to shut down one of their biggest income streams.\n\nBe careful, though. Those guys really know their business.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_85_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Looks like you were the biggest name on that arena after all. Impressive!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_86_OBJECTIVE
Text: One of our elites was captured by the Eastern Queens. They intend to sell her in their high profile slave auction. Rescue her!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_86_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You got there in time! We owe you big thanks.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_87_OBJECTIVE
Text: The owner of Queen of Diamonds club is also behind all of its dealings. She is called Queen Mary and her husband is Rockhead. Kill them both!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_87_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good to see Queen of Diamonds is out of business.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_88_OBJECTIVE
Text: The New Breed need space to live in. Today it is your duty to help us claim that space, little human.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_88_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: This will help a future for the New Breed!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_89_OBJECTIVE
Text: I think I know where all these muties are coming from. Check out the abandoned Gentec lab in Foundry Way and see what you can find out.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_89_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Holy crap, those poison cans contain mutagens?\n\nDamn, I need a shower.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_90_OBJECTIVE
Text: There seems to be a link between heat and these new mutants.\n\nYou need to go in and make sure that no new mutant gets outside to see the light of the day.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_90_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That was not pretty, but I breathe easier knowing that it was done.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_91_OBJECTIVE
Text: We just found the mother of all lizards. And I mean literally!\n\nShe is in the tunnel under Power Drive. Kill her before she wrecks the whole place.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_91_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Woo-hoo! I plan to move into the lizard skin boots business!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_92_OBJECTIVE
Text: I just got a call from a doctor called Smythe. He is stuck at the Hospital located in a really bad area we call \qRiot Town\q. You need to go in and kill the hooligan leader holding him hostage.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_92_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You think the Hooligans were the real problem? Labycore has decided to purge everyone from this area to sweep its problems under the rug.\n\nWe need to escape! Now!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_93_OBJECTIVE
Text: A helicopter! I can get us out, but you need to kill that Supersoldier first.\n\nAnd keep me safe! I don't want to sound pompous, but if I die, so does everyone else.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_93_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Mutant Supersoldier's? Purge patrols? Smythe piloting anything bigger than a shopping cart?\n\nAnd I thought Riot Town was bad before.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_94_OBJECTIVE
Text: We desperately need parts and supplies to keep this Health Station running. Gather some from the desert, and we'll give you a nice finder's fee.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_95_OBJECTIVE
Text: Labycore still controls the means of production, so we have to reuse and recycle. Go grab some of the heavy metal those Mill Park mutants are toting around.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_96_OBJECTIVE
Text: We're preparing for a big push against the Queens. Can you help us collect some supplies?

Name: TID_MISSION_1_96_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Nice loot! These will be a huge help in our outfitting. Here's your share.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_97_OBJECTIVE
Text: Another straggler? Make yourself useful and search that wreck park for some ammo. Bring me 6 boxes and I'll let you in.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_97_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great! I'll give you my card. You can now order damage boosters from me if you lack ingredients. It will take a while for me to deliver them, though.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_98_OBJECTIVE
Text: My old gang is out there, groaning and drooling. Put them out of their misery, OK? I'll make it worth your while.\n

Name: TID_MISSION_1_98_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Rest in pieces, friends. They can't thank you but I can. Here you go.\n

Name: TID_MISSION_1_99_OBJECTIVE
Text: Dang! I think we got sea water in your drink. Can you bring some metal from the scrapyard so I can fix our water tanks?\n

Name: TID_MISSION_1_99_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you! Now... Here are some bolts. Craft a pair of fine grenades for your own good!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_100_OBJECTIVE
Text: There are more survivors at the harbor area? If we got the word out, someone might rescue us. Go see IzaK. He runs a radio station from a garage down the street.

Name: TID_MISSION_1_100_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Welcome to Rotten Radio! I guess Dave finally found someone capable enough!\n

Name: TID_MISSION_1_101_OBJECTIVE
Text: We are low on power. There are car batteries at the deserted mall. Go and get us some!

Name: TID_MISSION_1_101_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Oh boy, here we go! Here, chew on this while I rig these babies up.\n

Name: TID_MISSION_1_102_OBJECTIVE
Text: What... Labycore is jamming my frequencies! Well, I can play dirty too! Go to the scrapheap and find me some parts!\n

Name: TID_MISSION_1_102_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Consider this a downpayment. If we get out of here, we can share the movie rights!\n
